headline: Wells Fargo and Cisco Object to OKXICE Tokenized Stock Plans
summary: Wells Fargo, Cisco, and Marvell joined other major firms in objecting to OKXICE's plans to list tokenized versions of their stock, bringing total objections to 22 companies.
why: Tokenized stocks bridge traditional equities and digital asset trading venues, raising complex regulatory, intellectual property, and compliance concerns for public corporations.

impacts.name: Wells Fargo
impacts.why: Corporate objections prevent unauthorized secondary tokenization of equities on external digital platforms.
